audience: marketing and sales teams that clean email lists before they send

useCases.title: Check one address before import
useCases.text: Validate one email address and read its result: deliverable, risky, disposable or role-based. Each check spends credits.

useCases.title: Check a domain against the disposable list
useCases.text: Check whether an address or domain is on the disposable-provider list. This check spends no credits.

useCases.title: Clean a whole list in bulk
useCases.text: Start a bulk check of a public CSV or TXT list, then read the job status until it completes. Get the results from the download link.

useCases.title: Track credits and API usage
useCases.text: Read the validation credits left on the account and the API call counts for a date range.
